title: Geometry of Unimodular Random Hyperbolic Polyhedra
summary: We develop a geometric and probabilistic theory of unimodular random infinite trivalent hyperbolic polyhedra in $\mathbb{H}^3$, allowing ordinary, ideal, and hyperideal vertices. Our results relate local dihedral geometry to global conformal type and random-walk behavior. A central role is played by a geometric characteristic $L_f(P)$, determined by the dihedral angles incident to a face $f$. We establish the unimodular Gauss-Bonnet identity $$ \mathbb E[L_f(P)]=2π-\fracπ{3}\mathbb E[deg(f)]. $$ Together with circle-pattern uniformization, this yields a sharp parabolic-hyperbolic dichotomy…
